description: duo CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record): the stack this plugin's own tests run in. Installs duo alone (it declares no dependencies); the consumer flips self to editable so the checkout under test runs, not the pinned revision. Population is empty: v0 ships no GRIFT. Deliberately excluded: every other plugin, all credentials, anything that reaches the network.

plugins.note: Self, pinned at the bootstrap commit until the first tagged release; the consumer (plugin-ci, or `spawn --dev-plugins duo`) substitutes the checkout under test via tap.dev_workspace (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record-4).
